summary: First-pass end-to-end testing of Live Trading Control Tower (Vite+TS+Tailwind FE, FastAPI BE). Backend: 19/19 pytest tests pass (100%) — all /api/* endpoints in server.py return the expected fixture shapes with correct counts (3 deployments / 2 brokers / 2 accounts; 2 live / 3 ghost / 5 blocked EURUSD trades; 144-cell-seed matrix; 82 CAUTION confidence). Frontend: All spec-required flows work — redirect to /fleet, 3 deployment cards render, System Confidence gauge shows 82 CAUTION, CT wordmark visible, deployment click navigates to /pair/EURUSD/overview with EURUSD, Bull/Expand 96%, v18 header, all 6 pair tabs render error-free, Policy Matrix has exactly 144 cells with 5 lens buttons all switchable, cell click opens Inspector with Policy Cell details (cohort/target/risk/eligibility/evidence/market-state), Command Palette opens with all 4 command groups (Navigate/Pair/Policy Matrix/Deployments), Trading tab shows 1 open trade (+0.90R managing), 1 closed, 5 blocked intents with 5 distinct reasons, 3 ghost trades and execution queue, clicking the trade opens Inspector with DecisionChain, EventDock toggles collapse/expand, Theme toggle flips console-dark ↔ midnight-navy (bg rgb changes and data-theme attribute set), all 5 global nav routes navigate. No JS page errors captured.

ui_bugs.issue: The <Card> component did not accept/forward the `data-testid` prop, so every consumer (FleetOverview deployment cards, blocked-intent cards, etc.) had its data-testid dropped before reaching the DOM. This broke test automation for `deployment-card-{id}` and any other Card-wrapped testid. FIXED by testing agent — added `'data-testid'?: string` to CardProps and spread it onto the underlying <div>. Verified: 3 deployment-card-* testids now render and clicking one navigates to /pair/EURUSD/overview.

action_items: Fix applied by tester: Card now forwards data-testid. Main agent should confirm no regressions and consider extending the same pattern to any other primitive that owns interactive DOM (IconButton, Panel etc.) so consumer testids never get silently dropped.
React Router v6 future-flag warnings (v7_startTransition, v7_relativeSplatPath) appear in console — non-blocking but easy to silence by adding `future` prop on BrowserRouter.
critical_code_review_comments: Card in Panel.tsx originally destructured a fixed prop list and did NOT spread rest, silently dropping `data-testid` and any other HTML pass-through attribute — anti-pattern for a design-system primitive; prefer `...rest` spread or an explicit allow-list including data-* attrs.

Backend policy_matrix() route accepts an optional `version` query param but the fixture-provider abstraction on FE synthesises the 144 cells from just 4 seed cells — that expansion logic lives only on the FE. When the API is wired later, the same deterministic expansion must move server-side or be duplicated, otherwise UI-vs-API contracts will drift.
server.py uses `@app.on_event('shutdown')` which is deprecated in modern FastAPI; consider migrating to lifespan context manager.

Backend imports motor and opens an AsyncIOMotorClient at module load even though no route uses it yet — will fail-fast if MONGO_URL is unset, which is fine, but adds startup coupling for a stub. Consider lazy init.
No _id field leakage detected — endpoints serve dict data straight from JSON fixture, so MongoDB ObjectID pitfalls are avoided in v1.
seed_data_creation: None — all backend responses come from the frozen /app/backend/fixtures/world.v1.json fixture.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_control_tower_api.py (19 tests, pytest, JUnit output at /app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml). It hits the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Frontend fixture provider synthesises 144 cells from 4 seed cells in world.v1.json; the /api/policy/{pair}/matrix endpoint returns only the seed cells today — this is by design per the PRD (fixtures still primary in v1). One fix was applied by the tester: Card component now forwards data-testid. All spec-listed data-testids are now reachable in the DOM: deployment-card-{id}, matrix-lens-{lens}, matrix-cell-{cellKey}, policy-matrix, command-palette-trigger, command-palette, command-palette-input, inspector-close, pair-workspace-tabs, event-dock-toggle, event-dock-content, theme-toggle, global-kill-button, decision-chain, scope-navigator, replay-play.
rca of the issue: Root cause of the initial deployment-card-* invisibility: Card component in components/structures/Panel.tsx declared its props via a closed CardProps interface and destructured only {children,className,onClick,interactive,selected}. Any additional prop passed by consumers (including data-testid) was silently dropped before the returned <div>. FleetOverview did the right thing (`data-testid={\`deployment-card-${d.deploymentId}\`}`) but React never reached the DOM. Fix: extended CardProps with `'data-testid'?: string`, kept the explicit destructure for known props and added `...rest`, then spread `data-testid={rest['data-testid']}` on the div. Reproduction was: page.eval_on_selector_all('[data-testid^="deployment-card-"]', ...) returned length 0 even though 3 cards were visually rendered. After the fix, the same selector returns exactly 3 ids and clicking the first navigates to /pair/EURUSD/overview as expected.
